generation.notes: Written by a sub-agent of the orchestrating session from the application-batch brief. Bilateral filter whose neighbourhood grows with strength (5 to 13 pixels); every worker adds seeded Gaussian noise to the resized frames when it starts. One item takes about 6 ms at default settings, 1.4 to 22 ms over the data_quality range and about 80 ms at the heaviest settings.
